Aaron Baptiste’s work on securing our threat intel platform using microservices and PostgreSQL has been critical. His Terraform pipelines automated 80% of infrastructure provisioning, cutting deployment cycles from days to hours.  

He architected a microservices backbone handling 10k+ requests/sec with zero downtime, using Go for high-throughput services. His REST APIs are clean, well-documented, and integrated seamlessly with our SIEM tools. He also built a Python-centric toolchain that reduced manual triage time by 35%.  

Aaron’s PostgreSQL expertise shines in optimizing complex queries, shrinking response times by 50% in high-load scenarios. He mentors junior engineers on best practices, and his code is consistently reliable—no major bugs in two years.  

A reliable, detail-oriented teammate who tackles problems proactively. Would strongly recommend him for any role requiring deep technical rigor and system-scale thinking.
